The minutes of the Supervisors of the Checklist for the Town of Londonderry 
Chairperson Kristin Grages called the meeting to order at 6:00pm.   Supervisors Kristin Grages and John Ambrose were present. Joe Stelmach was absent. 
The Supervisors reviewed and entered new voters, reviewed and amended existing voters for name, address and party changes, and, where available, reviewed evidence from the 
SVRS database, the NH Department of Vital Records, the NH Department of Corrections, the Londonderry Town Assessors office, and formal notice from other States to remove 
voters. The full count and names are included below as attached. The Supervisors printed out a list of removed voters to be used to organize the physical voter files. All voter records 
removed from the active files will be retained for seven years.  
The Supervisors reviewed the NCOA report and amended voter records, sent 30-day letters and removed voters where appropriate.  
The Supervisors will meet next Election Day September 8 at Londonderry High School.  
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the addition or amendment of 91 voters. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor.   
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the removal of 89 voters due to death, 30-day notice, registering outside of Londonderry, NCOA or voter ineligibility. John Ambrose seconded. All 
voted in favor. 
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the August 5 Minutes. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor. 
Kristin Grages motioned to adjourn at 8:27 pm. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor.
